summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Wages of War Casino. Backend: 28/28 pytest tests pass covering auth (register/login/me/logout/duplicate/invalid), slots list+detail+spin (min bet 20 + insufficient + auth), keno (invalid picks 0/11/out-of-range), coinflip (heads/tails/invalid side), daily bonus flow + 24h cooldown, wallet transactions, leaderboard, 8 VIP tiers, 5 credit packages, Stripe checkout session creation + status endpoint. Frontend: landing branding + compliance ('Wages of War Operations Ltd', MGA/B2C/912/2025) confirmed, 'War of Wages' NEVER appears; ENLIST flow works, header balance appears, daily SUPPLY DROP claim credits balance 10000->10500; lobby shows 6 slot cards + Keno + Coinflip; slot spin animates and updates balance and last payout; Keno pick+launch draw shows drawn numbers; Coinflip returns HEADS/TAILS with balance update; Wallet shows balance, 5 credit packages (Recon/Strike/Assault/Command/Warlord), and transaction history including enlistment bonus; protected /wallet and /profile routes redirect anonymous users to landing and open auth dialog.

issues: Missing Description/aria-describedby on DialogContent (a11y console warning). Non-blocking.

action_items: OPTIONAL: NAV.wallet testId ('nav-wallet') is exported from casino.js but not attached anywhere in Layout.jsx. Wallet is reachable via nav-balance chip and user-menu dropdown, so this is only a testId consistency cleanup.
OPTIONAL: Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to auth dialog to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: adjust_balance() reads then writes biggest_win non-atomically - potential race under concurrent spins. Use $max operator instead.
CORS uses FRONTEND_URL from env + localhost (good). allow_origins is explicit list which is correct for credentials.
bcrypt password hashing used correctly ($2b$ hash), JWT cookie httpOnly+secure+samesite=none (correct for cross-site preview).
Seed admin idempotent and updates password if it changed - matches playbook.
server.py is 665 lines - acceptable but nearing suggested 700 threshold; splitting payments and auth into modules would help future growth.
_ensure_price iterates all Stripe products with auto_paging_iter on every checkout - can be slow at scale; consider caching mapping in DB.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@wagesofwarcasino.com / WagesOfWar2025! (verified). New users registerable via /api/auth/register.
seed_data_creation: Test users created with email prefix 'test_' via register endpoint; multiple ephemeral test accounts created during runs (idempotent duplicate email guard verified).
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py at /app/backend/tests/ is the canonical regression suite (pytest with xdist parallel). Frontend has data-testids per src/constants/testIds/casino.js. Note: NAV.wallet testId is exported but unused; use NAV.balance ('nav-balance') chip in header to navigate to /wallet. Auth uses httpOnly cookies + Bearer token fallback (register/login responses include token in JSON). Protected routes /wallet and /profile redirect anonymous users to landing and open auth dialog.
rca of the issue: N/A - no issues found. Initial 2 backend test failures were self-inflicted (my tests hardcoded uppercase 'TEST_' email prefix while backend correctly lowercases emails per spec); fixed test data and all 28 tests pass.
